notes: TRAP for solo use - the module is cheap because the chassis isn't. THE REAL TRAP IS STRUCTURAL: HL-225 is OAM-only, has NO PCIe SKU, and needs the Gaudi UBB chassis (Supermicro 820GH-TNR2 ~$11,995 for the 8-module baseboard) plus a 24x 100GbE fabric to even light up. You cannot put one in a workstation. 96 GB HBM2e / 2460 GB/s, 600 W. SynapseAI/vLLM-fork works but the ecosystem is thin and Intel is winding the line down. MLPerf v4.0 8x aggregate 8,034.85 output tok/s is batch-1024 serving, not single-stream (record comm-gaudi2-8x-llama2-70b-fp8-mlperf).
